summary: A 1965 CDF 809R cab on an enclosed 29 ft steel tower in Mendocino County; last staffed in 1990, now closed; a visitor's report says it is boarded up.

facts.design: CDF 809R cab on an enclosed 29 ft steel tower; post-1950 cabin design with angled windows

access.note: NHLR describes the 1965 station as closed. A visitor's trip report on Bay Area Peaks describes the old lookout as securely boarded up. No source describes a visitor arrangement.

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry (NHLR lists it as administered by the CDF; Cal Fire nominated it)

events.note: Station built; NHLR and Peakbagging.com both date it to 1965

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR gives 2,645 ft (806 m), which matches the record. Peakbagging.com gives 2,739 ft for the same lookout, a difference of about 94 ft. The story gives both figures and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Sources are thin. The NHLR is the main source; the Forest Lookouts page supplies the 1990 budget-cut note; Peakbagging.com has a 2006 photo caption; the Bay Area Peaks trip report is undated. The Forest Lookouts page also lists 1931-1938 items about Signal Ridge and a Greenwood lookout, and a 1956 Ground Observer Corps entry that does not clearly name this site; none of these were used. The ffla-ccwr.org page in the brief could not be fetched (name resolution failed), so it was not read. No current owner or access policy was found. No source read places the station on the summit, so the story does not say so.
